name: Speko

team.summary: Founder Bek spent four years as cofounder and CTO building voice agents for enterprises across Asia in 10+ languages.

product.summary: Speko is a platform and API that finds an optimal combination of speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models based on user constraints (accuracy, latency, cost, balanced) and benchmarks, featuring a hosted router and an open-source gateway for BYOK mode.

market.summary: Developers and companies building production voice agents (such as property management AI and medical teams) looking to optimize their model stack across STT, LLM, and TTS.

risks.risk: The industry may move toward end-to-end trained single models rather than three-piece architectures (STT, LLM, TTS), reducing the long-term value of multi-model routing.
Stakeholders often make model selection decisions once at the start of a project, which may limit the recurring demand for a dynamic routing layer.

founder_depth.why: The founder has deep domain experience, having spent 4 years as cofounder and CTO building enterprise voice agents across Asia in 10+ languages before launching Speko.

shipping_evidence.why: The team launched a functional platform, public benchmark boards across multiple languages, an OpenAPI/AsyncAPI hosted router, and open-sourced their gateway binary on GitHub.

demand_signal.why: The HN post received 118 points and 69 comments with active customer stories (property management AI, medical team, property founder) and external usage growing ~25 percent per week since late June.

defensibility.why: Defensibility relies heavily on continuous benchmark data collection and impartial test runners, though multi-model routing faces architectural threats from emerging end-to-end voice models.

analysis.verdict_reason: Speko is built by an experienced technical founder solving a real workflow pain for voice agent developers, backed by solid early traction and shipping evidence.
would_change_my_mind: Voice agents universally shift to single end-to-end omni-models, eliminating the multi-vendor STT/LLM/TTS stack.
Customer churn accelerates because teams truly only choose their voice stack once and never switch.
Public benchmarks prove insufficient to maintain provider neutrality or trust.
data_gaps: Exact revenue or paying customer count numbers.
Detailed team composition beyond the solo founder mention.
